decision.observation: Jaydenosk Petch's passport is positioned on the right and shows nationality IMPOR, so it must be denied under the Arstotzkan-citizens-only rule. The stamp-bar tab is visible at the right edge.
decision.hypothesis: Clicking the right-edge tab will open the stamp bar so the passport can be marked DENIED.
decision.memory: Every entrant needs a passport; only Arstotzkan citizens may enter. After stamping, drag the passport directly onto the entrant to return it.
